title: SettingsSourceResponse
description: Where each setting that exists both in the deployment configuration and in the database takes its values from, and which deployment values the stored configuration currently overrides.

overriddenField.description: A field set deliberately in the deployment configuration whose stored value differs.

path.description: JSON pointer of the field inside the setting, for example /oidcConfiguration/clientAuthenticationMethod.

envVariable.description: Environment variable that sets the field in the deployment configuration, when the configuration file uses one.

source.description: Where the setting takes its values from.

sourceVariable.description: Environment variable that selects the source of this setting.

editable.description: False when every field of the setting is owned by the deployment configuration.

managedPaths.description: Fields owned by the deployment configuration. They cannot be changed through the API.

overriddenFields.description: Fields set deliberately in the deployment configuration whose stored value differs.

lastReloadError.description: Why this server could not apply the latest stored value of the setting, if it could not.

settings.description: One entry per setting that exists both in the deployment configuration and in the database.
